about: Cull verdicts for the Charts 'focus' highlight (Pablo t1705u test: undervalued, oversold, underappreciated; full grades in the Nov 25 cull). The engine (build_module.py) reads this plus the live Max Buy recipe state and writes a 'focus' field per name into engine.json: tier 'buy' = verdict keep + confirmed closed-week Max Buy with rung 1 due (act mbbuy); tier 'gun' = verdict keep + an active recipe plan waiting on a Max Buy or an add; tier 'exit' = held name graded out; everything else plain. The Sunday scan only has to update maxbuy-labels.json; names move between Buy now and Gunning for on their own. Change a verdict here only when a name is re-graded. Verdicts: keep, core (flag only), hold (keep, no adds targeted), meme (flag only), out (held, exiting), drop (watch, dropped).
